title: 0.38 Second Rubik's Cube Solve
summary: Ben Katz's custom robot solves a Rubik's Cube in 0.38 seconds. The description links to the hardware and software write-ups.
why: Cited as proof that machines solved the cube in under a second years ago, often as the earlier record before newer robots.

quote.text: In 2018, this was solved by some guys (I believe one worked for Boston Dynamics) in 0.38s.
